description:
draft-ietf-mls-combiner (combiner-02), Combiner Protocol Execution / Cipher Suites. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-combiner at 380f0e1, L167.

Text: "in {{commit-flow}}. In either case, PQ group MUST be instantiated with an approved PQ ciphersuite as detailed in {{I-D.ietf-mls-pq-ciphersuites}}."

Problem: Most suites in draft-ietf-mls-pq-ciphersuites-06 are hybrid (TBD1-5 and TBD9), but lines 624-626 and 639-640 forbid hybrid KEMs in the PQ session. No registry column classifies suites as traditional, pure PQ or hybrid, so the 'invalid or duplicate' check at lines 632-633 cannot be tested.

Suggested fix: List the permitted pq_cipher_suite values: the pure ML-KEM suites TBD6-8, TBD10 and TBD11 for mode 0, and only TBD10 and TBD11 for mode 1. Constrain t_cipher_suite to the RFC 9420 suites, and define 'duplicate'.

Severity: medium. Verifier: keep (Confirmed against pq-ciphersuites-06 lines 232-252. TBD1-5 and TBD9 are hybrid (MLKEM768X25519 or MLKEM+ECDH), and lines 624-626 and 639-640 forbid hybrid KEMs, so 'approved PQ ciphersuite as detailed in' is broader than what is allowed.)
